description: Execute Accrual/Deferral of Expenses and Revenues - selection screen. Test Run decides simulate vs commit, same trap as TBB1.

companyCode.title: Company Code
companyCode.note: From/to pair - nth 0 is the 'from' selection field.

transaction.title: Financial Transaction
transaction.note: From/to pair - nth 0 is the 'from' selection field, used to scope the run to one deal.

valuationClass.title: Valuation Class
valuationClass.note: Coded value, e.g. '0005' (Valuation Area 001) = Short Term. Read from the field's own F4 value help, never guessed - see discover-tpm-valuation-class.spec.ts.

keyDate.title: Accrual/Deferral Key Date
keyDate.note: Defaults to today. Set to the deal's month-end key date, not its term start.

testRun.note: Defaults to ON, discovered via a [role=checkbox] dump (discover-tpm-checkboxes.spec.ts) - dumpScreen cannot see it. Left alone, a 'post' simulates, reports success and writes nothing, same trap as TBB1's M0:46:::31:5.
